jobs.description: Job Description:Xaver is a fast-growing FinTech founded by an experienced leadership team that previously built venture-backed companies generating millions in revenue. Operating in a regulated market with over €100 billion in volume, we are backed by leading founders, experienced industry executives, and top international VCs. Our wealth manager operates as a BaFin-supervised financial institution.Most people in Germany do not save enough for retirement, and the current system makes financial planning complex and inaccessible. At Xaver, we are building next-generation digital pension and wealth management solutions to solve this structural challenge. We partner with top-tier insurers, broker networks, and financial institutions that leverage our platform to deliver modern wealth management to their customers.Your Role:As a Senior Backend & Infrastructure Developer , you will play a critical role in engineering the backbone of our platform. You will be responsible for translating complex financial, insurance, and broker workflows into resilient, performant backend services and scalable cloud infrastructure.You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our CPTO, Product Managers, and Staff Engineers, taking technical ownership of business-critical logic and helping shape architectural decisions across our ecosystem.Our Tech Stack• Language & Frameworks: TypeScript, Nest.js (Next.js on the frontend)• Databases & Caching: MongoDB, Redis• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Infrastructure as Code (IaC)• CI/CD & Tooling: Bitbucket Pipelines, GitYour Key Responsibilities:• Core Business Logic: Design, build, and optimize backend domain logic handling insurance broker flows, financial calculations, portfolio operations, and consumer-facing pension transactions.• Service Architecture & Inter-Backend Communication: Define and implement robust communication patterns between internal microservices, partner APIs, and asynchronous event streams.• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own, maintain, and scale our AWS infrastructure, ensuring high availability, observability, and cost-efficiency.• CI/CD & Automation: Evolve our Bitbucket Pipelines to ensure smooth, secure, and automated testing and deployment workflows.• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Staff Engineering, Product Management, and the CPTO to refine product specs, break down complex requirements, and set technical standards.• Security & Compliance: Build secure, auditable, and resilient systems that adhere to the high compliance and data protection standards of a BaFin-regulated financial institution.Your Qualifications:• Extensive Backend Experience: Proven track record in designing and maintaining production-grade backends using TypeScript and Nest.js (or modern Node.js frameworks).• Database & In-Memory Expertise: Deep working knowledge of schema design, indexing, and query optimization in MongoDB , paired with practical caching and queueing patterns using Redis .• Cloud & Infrastructure Fluency: Hands-on experience architecting and managing workloads on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation).• Distributed Systems Mindset: Solid understanding of inter-service communication (REST, gRPC, message brokers/event-driven architectures) and resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, distributed tracing).• Domain Problem Solving: Experience translating complex real-world rules (fintech, banking, insurance, or e-commerce) into clear, testable, and maintainable domain code.• Communication & Mindset: Collaborative attitude, pragmatic decision-making, and strong communication skills in English.• Nice to Have: Frontend familiarity with Next.js is a welcome plus, though not a hard requirement.Reporting to:CPTOLocation:KölnWhat We Offer:• High Impact: Direct co-ownership over foundational architecture in a €100B+ market with no legacy constraints.• Direct Access to Leadership: A flat hierarchy where you collaborate daily with Staff Engineers, Product Leads, and the CPTO.• Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary reflecting your senior experience, plus company perks.• Modern Equipment: Latest MacBook Pro (or your choice of hardware) and productivity tooling.• Workplace: Modern office space in central Cologne , with a flexible hybrid work model.• Benefits & Perks:• Urban Sports Club membership subsidy• A Round-the-World flight ticket to celebrate your 4th anniversary with XaverApplication Process:Send us your CV and your GitHub/portfolio link (or code samples/open-source contributions) via the company link. No cover letter, photo, or date of birth required.About usXaver enables Financial Institutions to close Europe’s pension gap. By offering an advanced AI-driven B2B platform for life insurance and private pension sales, Xaver enhances the operational and sales efficiency of banks, insurers, and brokers by up to 65% and introduces a new era of white-labeled private pension products.With a leadership team of experienced industry veterans - Max Bachem, Ole Breulmann Dr. Björn Holste and Nigel Jankelson - and backing from leading VC funds and a prominent group of former financial institution executives, fintech pioneers, and unicorn founders, Xaver is dedicated to improving the pension situation of Europeans through their B2B offering.

jobs.occupation: Post-Doc position: AI-Driven Robotic Experimentation for Controlling Metal Degradation (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Metal degradation can be a boon or a bane, depending on the application and on how well we can control it. A corroding car component is a safety risk. A biodegradable metal implant that dissolves at exactly the right rate spares patients a second surgery. An aqueous battery lives or dies depending on what happens at its electrodes.At the Department of Electrochemistry and Big Data we unravel degradation pathways of light metals used in structural applications, medical devices and aqueous batteries. For these applications, degradation can be controlled using tailored electrolyte additives. The chemical space of possible additives is virtually infinite, so we do not test one-by-one. We run a robotic, high-throughput testing platform coupled with machine learning and AI agents that help to decide which experiment to run next. Join us to build the self-driving laboratory of corrosion science.We are offering a 2‑year Post-Doctoral position, as soon as possible, in the quickly developing field of robotic experimentation in materials science. The position is full-time (39 h/week) and will be located in Hereon's main campus, in Geesthacht (near Hamburg).We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We particularly encourage qualified women to apply.Your tasks- Run and extend automated experimental workflows on our robotic platform to test how light alloys respond to electrolytes of increasing complexity- Discover high-performing organic and inorganic compounds that control degradation for structural and biomedical applications- Work side by side with computational scientists to build structure-property models, and use AI agents to accelerate screening- Uncover the mechanisms behind effective degradation control, and turn them into design rules for pre-selecting promising compounds- Publish your results in leading journals, present at international conferences, write project reports and contribute to open, FAIR datasetsYour profile- A completed master's and PhD degree in chemistry, electrochemistry, materials science, computational materials science or a related field- Solid experimental skills in chemical laboratories and confidence in quantitative data analysis using appropriate software- Experience with corrosion, electrochemical methods or light alloys (Mg, Al, Zn)- Experience with lab automation, electronic lab notebooks, FAIR data, databases or machine learning- Curiosity about automation and AI, and motivation to work at the interface of experiment and computation- Very good English, knowledge of the German language is preferred but not mandatory, we support language learningContent-related enquiries regarding this position can be directed to Sviatlana.Lamaka(at)hereon.de.Our offer- Access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- Access to a large international research and industrial network.- Funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- An exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- An International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's DaySocial benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)A well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions, and charging facilities for electric vehicles- Individual opportunities for further training- An excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- A family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e. g. a daycare center close to the workplace- Workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- Corporate Benefits- A varied canteen offering on campusSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.Bitte bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem vollständigen Bewerbungsprofil (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, sonstige Referenzen) über unsere Karriereseite.

Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für einen Zeitraum von i. d. R. 3 Jahren, zu besetzen. Asif Ali Khan arbeitet an der Schnittstelle zwischen neuartigen Rechnerarchitekturen und Compilern und nutzt dabei sowohl herkömmliche als auch neuartige nichtflüchtige Speichertechnologien. Zu den Forschungsgebieten zählen In-Memory- und Near-Memory-Computing sowie die Entwicklung von Modellierungs- und Simulationsframeworks und Kostenmodellen für diese neuartigen Systeme. jobs.occupation: Postdoc - automated high-throughput screening of electrolyte adduces for aqueous batteries (Ingenieur/in - Materialwissenschaften)
jobs.description: The postdoctoral candidate will work within an international research project focused on improving the performance and long-term stability of aqueous batteries through the development of advanced electrolyte additives.The central objective of the project is to establish an integrated high-throughput workflow combining robotic electrolyte preparation, automated electrochemical testing, and machine-learning-assisted analysis.The work involves extensive experimental laboratory activities, automated testing, electrochemical characterization, data analysis, and close cooperation with industrial project partners. The candidate will contribute to the development of reproducible and data-driven battery research workflows for sustainable, safe, and cost-effective stationary energy-storage technologies.The position is full-time (39 h/week) and fixed-term for 18 months, starting in February 2027.Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.Your tasks- Develop and optimize automated high-throughput workflows for the preparation and electrochemical screening of aqueous electrolyte formulations.- Systematically screen a broad range of electrolyte additives and generate high-quality datasets linking electrolyte composition to battery performance.- Perform electrochemical characterization using techniques such as galvanostatic cycling, cyclic voltammetry, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.- Analyze large experimental datasets and contribute to the development and validation of machine-learning and quantitative structure-property relationship models.- Publish your results in leading peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences, write project reports.- Collaborate closely with researchers, data scientists, and industrial partners working on electrolyte synthesis, battery development, modelling, and scale-up.Your profileRecruitment requirement- A PhD in the subject areas of Materials science, Electrochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or similar.Required knowledge and personal skills- Strong background in electrochemistry and aqueous battery technologies.- Hands-on laboratory experience and interest in experimental research.- Experience with electrochemical measurements and data analysis.- Interest in automated experimentation and data-driven materials research.- Ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team.- Knowledge of techniques such as EIS, cyclic voltammetry, hydrogen evolution,  and electrode degradation.- Very good English language skills (at least B2/C1 level according to CEFR).Desired knowledge and personal skills- Experience with aqueous batteries, metal-anode batteries, or electrolyte development.- Experience with materials characterization techniques, such as microscopy, X-ray methods.- Experience with automated experimentation, robotics, data science, or machine learning is advantageous.Reach out with your CV and motivation letter expressing your interest and experience in the proposed topic. Got questions before applying? Contact Prof. Zheludkevich (Mikhail.zheludkevich@hereon.de), Dr. Lamaka (Sviatlana.lamaka@hereon.de) or Dr. Snihirova (darya.snihirova@hereon.de).Our offer- Access to state-of-the-art (robotic) labs, unique scientific and technical infrastructure- Access to a large international research and industrial network.- Funding for conferences, summer schools and courses needed or research stays- An exciting job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits according to the collective agreement of the public service and remuneration up to EG 13 (according toEntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible work- A green campus on the Elbe River, well-connected with Hamburg (public transport), subsidy for the Deutschlandticket if certain conditions are met (job ticket), charging facilities for electric vehicles- family-friendly company policy with childcare facilities, e.g. nursery/kindergarten close to the company- Operational Health Management, e.g. Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- Corporate BenefitsSeverely disabled persons and those equaling severely disabled persons who are equally suitable for the position will be considered preferentially within the framework of legal requirements.Interested? We are looking forward to receiving your application. Karriereseite.
